learning_outcomes.text: Students can use their basic knowledge of grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation to understand technical texts.
(Reading) Students can deeply understand basic and field-related technical texts by using text reading techniques.
(Writing) Students can write short definitions and instructions related to a specific topic and summarize texts.
(Listening) Students can develop listening comprehension skills, recognize grammatical patterns in speech, distinguish technical texts, and fill in blanks by following instructions in the book.

(Speaking) Students can answer short questions about technical topics, create short dialogues, express their ideas on discussion topics of the units, and use words appropriate to their level (e.g., expressing basic needs, asking questions about instructions or directions).
Students can communicate at a minimum level with learned material.
Students can follow technical developments in their field using different sources.
Students can translate simple technical texts from English to Turkish.

syllabus_topics: Bit, byte, LAN and WAN, Midterm Exam
bibliography: Philips T., ( 2023). Integrated Technical English. Nüans Publishing
